sections.title: Title, letter and planet
sections.line: Crowley's list of titles for Atu I to XXI (pdf p45) and his attribution of the card to the letter Beth and to Mercury (pdf p58).

quotes.quote: I. to XXI. The Juggler; The High Priestess; The Empress
This card is referred to the letter Beth, which means a house, and is attributed to the planet Mercury.

sections.title: The path of Beth
sections.line: Crowley on Mercury as the path leading from Kether to Binah (pdf p58) and on the path of Beth descending from Kether upon Binah (pdf p121).

sections.title: The Wisdom, the Will, the Word
sections.line: Crowley on the Logos by whom the worlds were created (pdf p58) and on Mercury and the path of Beth (pdf p59).

quotes.quote: This card therefore represents the Wisdom, the Will, the Word, the Logos by whom the worlds were created.
Mercury, however, represents action in all forms and phases.
In this card, the emphasis is upon the creative and dualistic character of the path of Beth.
